title: LBJ's secret mission to Prime Minister Sato on textile exports

tellings.quote: LBJ wants you to go on a very secret mission to Tokyo

plain: In 1964, Harold Malmgren, an adviser to American presidents, was told that President Lyndon B. Johnson wanted him to go on "a very secret mission to Tokyo" to see Japan's prime minister, Eisaku Sato, about textile exports. Malmgren tells Michels this himself and also names Christian Herter, and it shows how much the White House trusted him with sensitive work.
